meta.name: get-available-resources
meta.description: Detect host inventory and effective CPU, memory, disk, scheduler, container, and accelerator limits when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload. Produces a redacted JSON snapshot and conservative planning helpers without stress tests or assuming visible host hardware is usable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 获取主机可用资源快照，辅助运行前判断
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你常跑吃资源的大任务，想知道本机是否扛得住。
copy.tagline_en: Get a snapshot of your machine's available resources before launching a task.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run resource-heavy tasks and want to know whether your machine can handle them.

howto.what: 遇到计算量大的任务,它先运行脚本检测本机 CPU、GPU、内存、磁盘与操作系统,生成包含资源信息的 .claude_resources.json,再根据结果告诉你建议的并发任务数、是否用 GPU 加速、数据能否分块等。
howto.when: 当你说到要分析大文件、训练模型、并行处理很多文件等计算密集事件,或主动要求做资源感知规划时,它会先做资源检测。

say.text: 我有个 50GB 的 CSV,先查一下我这台机器内存够不够?
say.note: 会触发检测并给出内存/磁盘读取建议。

say.text: 这台电脑有没有能用的 GPU?用 PyTorch 训练该选什么后端?
say.note: 按检测结果中的 gpu 和可用后端回答。

say.text: 我要并行处理 10000 个文件,建议开多少个 worker?
say.note: 会读取建议中的 suggested_workers 数值。

howto.what_en: Runs resource detection for heavy tasks, saves a .claude_resources.json snapshot, and returns conservative planning guidance (CPU/GPU/memory/disk, parallelism, GPU backends).
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user requests resource-aware planning or starts a compute-heavy task, e.g. large dataset analysis, model training, parallel workloads, or GPU-heavy work.

say_en.text: I have a 50 GB CSV. Check whether this machine has enough memory to load it.
Does this computer have a usable GPU? Which backend should I pick for PyTorch?
I'm going to process 10,000 files in parallel. How many workers should I use?
